motion.name: bubble-daydream
motion.purpose: Bubble-sort planets reserve the maximum ring diameter plus 0.28 in each slot. Opposing semicircles exchange at constant path speed over 1.4s: depth in 3D, vertical clearance in 2D. Clay keeps the existing damped spring. Depth-tested native value sprites, signed DOM values and fixed indices retain numerical truth. Views share Canvas and trace clock; pause freezes the trace, nebula, twinkle and dust while independent axial rotation continues. Seek/edit restores exact trace geometry without resetting axial time. Reduced motion uses the static array renderer.

motion.name: bubble-view-transition
motion.purpose: Bubble native view radios ease between front-facing and shallow orthographic angle. Default 3D; 2D flattens z to 0.01 and hides rings while shader terrain rotates without turning geometry edge-on. Landing runs the actual trace in 3D. All space scenes render continuously while visible; offscreen or hidden documents use demand rendering.

motion.name: bubble-background
motion.value: domain-warped nebula; sparse star twinkle; faint swap ripple
motion.purpose: Bubble scene nebula, twinkle, dust and swaps share cumulative playback clock and speed. Pause freezes that trace clock; seek/edit/reset restores deterministic trace states. Independent planet axial rotation continues while visible, regardless of playback. Reduced motion or scene failure uses the static array renderer; no physics engine.

motion.name: clay-damped-spring
motion.purpose: Optional legacy clay swap interpolation only, over 1400ms on playback clock. Space planets use orbitalSwap semicircles; Big O uses a separate cubic opacity fade.

motion.name: native-space-sky
motion.value: uTime × 0.035 domain warp; sin(uTime × 0.28 + seed) twinkle
motion.purpose: Independent native WebGL highp landing/loading sky, DPR cap 1.5, ResizeObserver and resource cleanup. Hidden RAF stops, reduced motion is still, shader failure/context loss uses static CSS sky.

motion.name: complexity-star-fade
motion.purpose: Visible count changes fade opacity; first render, offscreen and reduced motion resolve to the final exact count and draw range. Stable local workStar coordinates, shared 6.5-unit camera and minimum 4px point-size rule remain unchanged up to 8128 stars. Visible non-hidden scenes render continuously for cluster turn/tilt, brightness pulse and local surface spin; offscreen/reduced scenes render on demand. Idle motion does not rewrite the count-fade alpha buffer.

motion.name: loading-moon
motion.purpose: Decorative native moon orbit; paused offscreen or in a hidden document and disabled for reduced motion, no fake delay.

motion.name: complexity-star-spin
motion.purpose: Each point shader rotates its asymmetric bright surface patch around its point centre; the rendered cluster also turns and tilts. Seed comes from stable local position. Exact counts, local geometry and shared scale remain unchanged. Visibility/document-hidden and reduced-motion gates stop the local clock, with delta capped at 0.1s; no physical-astronomy claim.

motion.name: loading-planet-spin
motion.purpose: Sage/ochre surface patches rotate beneath fixed inset lighting, using loading shade at 50% and ochre at 40%. Visibility/document-hidden gates pause CSS animation; reduced motion stops it.

motion.name: bubble-planet-spin
motion.value: period = 4 + clamp((radius − 0.13) / 0.4, 0, 1) × 2 seconds; angle = visibleSeconds × 2π / period + id × 0.8; delta ≤ 0.1s
motion.purpose: Every visible space planet rotates independently before playback and while sorting is paused, with a five-second baseline: small planets turn in 4s, medium in 5s and large in 6s. Speed follows rendered radius, not item ID; IDs retain only stable phases. 3D spins the actual sphere about y; 2D spins shader terrain while flattened geometry stays front-facing. Rings, numeric labels and fixed slot centres do not spin. Playback speed, pause, seek and trace reset do not control or reset axial time. Offscreen, hidden-document and reduced-motion gates stop nonessential motion.

motion.name: landing-preview-playback
motion.value: actual bubble.run([3,5,2,4,1,6]); 1x: step 2800ms; swap 1400ms; hold 6000ms; erode 6000ms; form 3000ms
motion.purpose: Shared useBubblePlayback enables autoplay for the landing preview only; lesson default remains stopped. Preview starts on visible entry and loops the real trace. Bilingual native pause/resume control is outside the lesson link; pausing sorting leaves independent axial spin running. Comparison operators, swap before/after pairs and explanations follow the actual current step. Visibility/document-hidden gate playback; reduced motion does not autoplay or show the pause control.

motion.name: complexity-cluster-motion
motion.value: Euler x = sin(seconds × 0.22) × 0.18; y = seconds × 0.18; z = sin(seconds × 0.16) × 0.05
motion.purpose: Rendered Points group turns and tilts around its fixed centre; stable local star coordinates yield moving projected positions. Counts, radii, equal point-size rule and shared camera remain unchanged up to 8128 stars. Visible non-hidden time advances with delta capped at 0.1s; offscreen/reduced scenes render on demand.

motion.name: complexity-star-pulse
motion.purpose: Seeded shader brightness pulse makes every cluster, including the one-star model, visibly alive. It multiplies the count-fade alpha without rewriting its buffer or changing exact draw count. Uses the same visibility/document-hidden/reduced-motion gates as cluster rotation.

narrative.overview:
The user-approved observatory now covers landing, loading, favicon, Big O and Bubble sort (2026-10-08). Numbered worn planets, sparse stars and diffuse green/mauve nebula make watching the invitation. Existing Korean/English product names, lighter type, precise evidence and reading order remain. The shared world extends the original Bubble direction (seed 7554e619); its surface expressions are recorded in `.impeccable/surfaces/bubble-space.md` and `.impeccable/surfaces/landing-space.md`.

Other algorithm lessons retain their light paper, muted sage surfaces, established layouts and execution colors. The observatory approval is scoped to the named surfaces; it does not invert every lesson. Playful bilingual introductions invite watching, while exact summaries, model formulas and step evidence support closer reading. Source code stays available below the execution canvas when curiosity calls.
keyCharacteristics: Low-light observatory on landing, loading, favicon, Big O and Bubble sort.
Light paper and sage actions on other algorithm lessons.
Worn numbered planets, procedural atmosphere and equally sized model stars.
Lighter headings and quiet bilingual copy.
Visible execution with code closed until requested.
Monospaced values and distinct execution states.

rules.name: The Scoped World Rule
rules.body: Apply the observatory to landing, loading, favicon, Big O and Bubble sort; other algorithm lessons keep their incumbent light palette and layout.

rules.name: The Shared Scale Rule
rules.body: Big O comparison scenes use the same star-size rule, stable local coordinates and camera units: more work means more stars, never normalized cluster size or larger individual stars.

rules.name: The Model Evidence Rule
rules.body: Pair geometric work counts with their exact formulas and the model caption; never describe them as measured runtime.

rules.name: The Printed Value Rule
rules.body: Bubble planet geometry is illustrative; exact signed numbers and fixed numeric slots are the algorithm evidence. Rings and exchange arcs do not describe astronomical measurements or simulated physics.

dos: Do preserve the Korean and English product names and use the approved orbital SVG/ICO identity mark.
Do keep Korean and English copy readable at narrow widths.
Do place playful taglines alongside exact summaries and step explanations.
Do lead with execution and keep code available through a closed native disclosure.
Do pair execution colors with textual or numeric evidence.
Do scope the observatory to landing, loading, favicon, Big O and Bubble sort while retaining other lessons’ light palette and layout.
Do treat printed signed Bubble values and fixed indices as authoritative over illustrative geometry.
donts: Don't present Bubble rings or swap arcs as astronomical measurements or physical simulation.
Don't present the Big O growth model as measured runtime.
Don't collapse comparison, swap, settled and matched lesson states into one accent.
Don't turn precise input constraints or error messages into jokes.
